tasks.short: Observe material and car details, then enter and check the movement observations.

steps.what: Observe car numbers, tonnages, grades and material conditions
Retrieve carrier and customer references for the observed cars
Record car numbers, carriers, customers, tonnages, grades and conditions
Check movement observations against car identity, readings and dispatch references

tasks.design: Configure car and dispatch reference views and native observation fields in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Physical observation is separate from lookup and record entry; the operator still captures condition and checks identity and quantities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated dispatch lookup and manual record structure slow observation recording.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference lists and validated fields can reduce repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Unreadable markings, uncertain material grade and physical condition.
tasks.human_edge: The operator observes the actual car and material rather than trusting a default.
tasks.altitude: Reduce observation-record handling without replacing physical checks.

reach.learn: Match physical identifiers to dispatch references

evidence.claim: Field service software supports structured tasks and parts records, an adjacent capability rather than a documented underground-mining result.
The proposed mining observation form benefit is an unmeasured E1 scenario.

assumptions: Counts actual observation, carrier/customer lookup, record writing and checking; no machine vision or automatic weighing import is implied.

Operator produces car ID, material grade, condition and observed tonnage in s1 and captures them with carrier/customer references in s3; capture time is counted. Missing identifiers require manual clarification.
Native views and form defaults first; grade and condition remain human observations.
Ordinary same-system saves remain in retained entry time without approval gates.
unknowns: Dispatch identifier quality and device availability underground
research_questions: Which fields can reuse verified references without obscuring wrong-car errors?

already_counted.description: Capture and check observed movement fields

incremental.description: Maintain reference lists and observation fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=86.5, gross=13.5, upkeep=2, central net=11.5 E1. Low: unreadable car IDs and unmatched dispatch data force manual entry, retaining 97 hours plus upkeep for 1 net. High: matched carrier references support some field reuse but condition and grade remain manual, retaining 91 hours plus upkeep for 7 net.

tasks.short: Read current movement instructions, clarify schedules with supervisors and record working clarifications.

steps.what: Retrieve current written instructions and schedules for materials to be moved
Read written instructions and assess their applicability to current conditions
Confer with supervisors about schedules, materials and unresolved movement questions
Record working clarifications and the current instruction reference

tasks.design: Use a current-shift instruction view in {OPS_SYSTEM} and a short reference-linked clarification template in {DOCS}. Reading, situational understanding and supervisor discussion remain human; any working note is priced separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable instruction version and formatting clarifications consume time around the discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-shift views and note fields can reduce navigation and formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Changing underground conditions and resolving ambiguous instructions.
tasks.human_edge: The operator can describe actual conditions and confirm mutual understanding.
tasks.altitude: Reduce instruction handling around direct operational coordination.

reach.learn: Keep working clarifications attached to instruction versions

evidence.claim: Native instruction views and note templates can reduce repeated navigation and formatting; this benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: Includes instruction retrieval, reading, supervisor clarification and existing working notes; do not create a new note requirement solely for saving.

Supervisor supplies the instruction and schedule through existing supervision; operator captures version, relevant schedule and clarification in s4, with time counted. Missing or conflicting versions require direct clarification.
Native views and templates first; no model interpretation or hidden dispatch message.
If the site has no working notes, remove both their baseline effort and benefit; ordinary saves require no approval.
unknowns: Current instruction access and working-note practice
research_questions: Are operators retrieving multiple versions or already receiving one current instruction?

already_counted.description: Capture the working clarification and instruction reference

incremental.description: Maintain current-instruction view and note fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94, gross=6, upkeep=1, central net=5 E1. Low: ad hoc instructions remain verbal and no reusable working-note format fits, retaining 99 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: reliable shift versions improve retrieval but operational clarifications remain bespoke, retaining 96 hours plus upkeep for 3 net.

tasks.short: Maintain material movement records and reconcile totals without repeating initial observations.

steps.what: Retrieve existing materials movement observations and register entries
Reconcile missing, duplicate or inconsistent materials movement records
Maintain movement register fields and enter substantiated corrections
Calculate register totals for materials moved by the selected shift and category
Check materials totals, correction traceability and unresolved record discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure register views, correction fields and grouped totals in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Initial observation capture belongs to task 15194; this task prices maintaining the register, resolving discrepancies and producing its totals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Register maintenance and manually assembled totals repeat record handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native register fields and grouped totals can support existing record maintenance.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining discrepancies and establishing which source is reliable.
tasks.human_edge: The operator can resolve what actually moved and substantiate corrections.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repetitive register maintenance while preserving source accountability.

reach.learn: Retain correction provenance and grouping definitions

evidence.claim: Native records applications can maintain correction fields and grouped totals; the proposed mining benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: Initial car/material observation and entry are owned by task 15194; this maintenance task does not claim those savings again.

Operator produces correction reason, source reference, material, quantity, unit and shift in s2-s3, with capture counted. Initial movement fields come from the operator's checked task-15194 record, whose capture remains priced there. Missing source fields require manual resolution.
Native register views and totals first; s4 consumes the explicit shift/material grouping selected during s3 and checked in s5.
Central scenario assumes current manual register totals; if already native, remove their 20-hour baseline and benefit. No same-system save saving or approval is claimed.
unknowns: Current separation of initial capture and register maintenance
research_questions: Which maintenance actions remain after initial movement entry and how are totals produced today?

incremental.description: Maintain register fields and verify grouping rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=66.5, gross=33.5, upkeep=4, central net=29.5 E1. Low: inconsistent shift identifiers and mixed material units require manual totals and correction entry, retaining 93 hours plus upkeep for 3 net. High: compatible identifiers allow grouped totals but incomplete correction provenance retains extra maintenance work, retaining 78 hours plus upkeep for 18 net.

tasks.short: Direct coworkers' immediate placement and movement activities under observed underground conditions.

steps.what: Assess positions, clearances and conditions before directing workers
Determine the sequence for moving stakes, blocks, anchors, cables or materials
Check and communicate final movement instructions directly to coworkers
Observe coworker movements and adjust or stop instructions as conditions change

tasks.design: Keep immediate assessment, sequence choice, direct instruction and observation human. A document template, native record view or machine setting does not perform these contemporaneous placement directions; no record write is folded into the conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on current positions and physical feedback rather than repeat data handling.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change credibly reduces these particular direct-work steps.
tasks.still_hard: Changing clearances, communication and immediate safety judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The operator sees the movement and can intervene immediately.
tasks.altitude: Retain direct situational control of coworker movements.

reach.learn: Use clear instructions and immediate feedback

evidence.claim: Immediate underground placement direction requires human observation and communication; no supported software labour saving is identified.

assumptions: This task is the immediate direction itself. No record, report or lookup is named or needed within these four steps; actual material observation records remain separately priced in tasks 15194 and 23502.
Operator produces the current position assessment and sequence in s1-s2 at full effort; there is no machine consumer or unpriced structured input.
Native views, templates and till or machine settings do not replace live observation, instructions or feedback here.
No software is introduced, so no new upkeep is added.
unknowns: Whether a site separately requires a written work-direction record
research_questions: Does observed practice include a distinct written instruction record that should be priced as another step?

incremental.description: No new software or maintenance work

approvals.approved_version: Exact instruction and intended coworker against current positions and clearances; changed conditions require a fresh check before direction.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, central net=0 E1. Conservative and favourable cases both retain physical assessment, sequence judgement, direct communication and observation. A reusable template does not shorten the contemporaneous physical coordination; any distinct written record found in practice must be separately priced.
